title: Run on a sequence of choice bits
statement: Given a nondeterministic register program, an oracle, and an input bit string, its run on a finite sequence of choice bits is obtained by processing those bits in order, applying one nondeterministic computation step for each bit; the empty sequence leaves the initial configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A is a nondeterministic register program with m registers and d deciders
oracle is a Boolean oracle for d deciders
x is an input bit string
